data.name: Adheem
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'd-h-m', meaning 'to ponder, to reflect, to think deeply'. In Islamic tradition, Adheem is a name given to a wise and intelligent child.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to possess a deep understanding of spiritual and worldly matters.
data.numerology_meaning: A name for a child who is destined for greatness and will have a strong spiritual connection to the world.

in_arabic.name: عظيم
in_arabic.meaning: عظيم الشأن، كبير القدر، شديد العظمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عظيم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عظم' الذي يعني كبر و علو الشأن. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 255 'وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ'، و في سورة الفتح آية 18 'وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ'. يدل على عظمة و قدرة الله تعالى. يستخدم كاسم للذات الرفيعة و العظيمة في الشأن

in_urdu.name: عظیم
in_urdu.meaning: عظیم الشان، بڑا قدر، شدید عظمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عظیم نام عربی جڑ 'عظم' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب بڑائی اور اہمیت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں اس کا استعمال اہل ذوق و معرفت کے لئے رواج رکھتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا تعلق عظمت اور بڑائی سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़ीम
in_hindi.meaning: अज़ीम शाँन, बड़ा कदर, شدید अज़मत
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीम नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'अज़म' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है महानता और महत्व। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग विशेष महत्व रखता है और इसे आध्यात्मिक दृष्टिकोण से शुभ माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عظیم
in_pashto.meaning: عظیم شان، لوی قدر، شديد عظمت
in_pashto.long_meaning: عظیم نوم د عربي جڑ 'عظم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د لویوالي او عزت دی. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې ددې نوم استعمال داهم معنی لري. پدې توګه د اسلامی نومونو دودیز استعمال دی.

in_english.name: Adheem
in_english.meaning: Great, magnificent, exalted, having a high status
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adheem originates from the Arabic root 'ʿ-z-m' which means greatness, grandeur, and magnificence. Referenced in the Quran, it signifies the exalted and mighty nature of Allah. Historically, it has been used to denote someone of high status, nobility, and grandeur. The name carries spiritual significance, reflecting attributes of majesty and power.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adheem holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic culture. In Arabic naming traditions, the name Adheem is often given to a child who is believed to exhibit traits of intelligence, thoughtfulness, and wisdom, as the name reflects these characteristics. This practice upholds the values of knowledge and intellect in the Islamic community, fostering a culture where education is valued and encouraged. Furthermore, it is a reminder to parents of the responsibility they have in nurturing their children's potential and intellect.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Adheem carries deeper spiritual significance. It serves as a reminder for the individual bearer of the name to reflect deeply on their actions, thoughts, and words, and to strive for wisdom and knowledge in their daily lives. The name also carries the blessings of reflecting on the teachings and prophets of Islam, and should inspire a sense of humility and gratitude for the gift of intelligence and wisdom bestowed upon them by Allah (God). Overall, the name Adheem embodies the Islamic values of wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of excellence in character and in life.
